lines.en: \c[1]Over two years passed since Protagonist first saw battle.  Two years that have changed Tahnra forever, but foremost in Protagonist's heart, forged friendships and bonds that will never be broken.
lines.zh: \c[1]自从Protagonist第一次参战以来已经过去了两年多。 这两年永远地改变了塔恩拉，但在Protagonist心中，最重要的是期间结下的永不破裂的情谊和羁绊。
